name: island
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One small island game sprite for a refined preschool tabletop logic puzzle. Strict overhead/top-down view, roughly circular organic oval silhouette. A quiet pale green grass surface with a delicate warm sand shore rim and a little exposed earth along the edge. Gently hand-painted 3D texture, softly rounded terrain, natural but very simple. The CENTRAL 70 percent must be calm, light and almost uniform, reserved for an overlaid large number and small text. No trees, palms, flowers, rocks, paths, buildings, people, boats, bridges, water outside the island, text, numbers, borders or symbols. Full island with comfortable margins on a genuinely transparent background. Soft warm light, clean alpha, no halo. Make a beautifully crafted readable island token, not a scene or map.
